ksb_text: Understands capabilities/limitations of GenAI tools for content drafting
Can prompt-engineer GenAI tools to produce first-draft learning content
Iteratively reviews and refines AI-drafted content rather than accepting output as-is
Understands key learning metrics (completion rate, assessment scores, time-to-competency)
Can build/read dashboards to track learning program effectiveness
Uses data to justify design decisions, not just intuition
Understands basic NLP concepts (keyword extraction, embeddings, similarity matching)
Can apply keyword/embedding-based tagging to classify content against a taxonomy
Validates NLP-driven tags/matches against subject-matter judgment before publishing
Understands principles of adaptive learning path design
Can configure/design a learner profile → path mapping logic
Designs for diverse learner starting points, not a single "average" learner
Knows ADDIE / competency-based design models
Can write measurable learning objectives
Applies design consistently across content types
Understands client's business context and compliance needs
Can translate vague client asks into a structured learning solution brief
Proactively manages client expectations on AI-generated content accuracy
Knows landscape of GenAI authoring/content tools
Can operate at least one GenAI content tool end-to-end in a real workflow
Stays current with new tool releases relevant to L&D
Understands system components of a learning tech stack (LMS, content repo, analytics)
Can design a data flow diagram for a personalized learning system
Designs for scalability/reusability, not one-off solutions
Understands KSB frameworks and taxonomy design principles
Can decompose a competency into measurable KSBs
Keeps taxonomy consistent and non-redundant across roles
Understands common AI content risks (hallucination, bias, compliance gaps)
Can run a structured QA review checklist on AI-generated content
Flags/escalates content that fails QA rather than letting it pass silently
